outOfScopeTemplate.en: I can only help with your booking, disruption, and rebooking/refund questions here — I'm not able to answer that.
outOfScopeTemplate.zh: 我只能帮您处理与本次预订、行程中断、改订或退款相关的问题，无法回答这个问题。
outOfScopeTemplate.mi: Ka taea e au te āwhina i ngā pātai e pā ana ki tō rēhita, te whakararu haerenga, te tuhi anō/utu whakahoki noa iho.

securityTemplate.en: For your security, I can't process passwords or look up other guests' information here. Please contact support directly if you need account help.
securityTemplate.zh: 出于安全考虑，我无法在这里处理密码或查询其他客人的信息。如需账号相关帮助，请直接联系客服。
securityTemplate.mi: Mō tō haumaru, kāore e taea e au te tuhi kupuhipa, kupu huna rānei i konei. Whakapā tika atu ki te tautoko.

escalationTemplate.en: Please hold on, a coordinator is looking into this for you — click here to chat with them.
escalationTemplate.zh: 请稍等，协调员正在处理，点此对话。
escalationTemplate.mi: Tēnā koa tatari, kei te tirotiro tētahi kaiwhakarite i tēnei mea māu — pāwhiritia ki konei ki te kōrero.

hotelAvailabilityTemplate.en: That's something only the hotel can confirm — I've reached out to them to check and will update you as soon as they respond. You can also view your rebooking options in the meantime.
hotelAvailabilityTemplate.zh: 这个只有酒店能确认，我已经联系酒店核实，一有结果就会通知您。您也可以先看看改签方案。
hotelAvailabilityTemplate.mi: Ko te mea tēnei ka taea noa e te whare hōtera te whakaū — kua whakapā atu ahau ki a rātau, ā, ka whakamōhio atu ahau i te wā ka whakautu mai rātau.
